subject: [COMPANY]'s labeled data pipeline at scale
text:
Hi [NAME],

Noticed your team from [COMPANY] recently checked out a demo on our website,
thought I'd reach out directly, given your work on HITL workflow automation
and data curation for the Driver.

Teams we've seen typically run into two things: annotation bottlenecks on
long-tail edge cases and HITL workflows that don't scale with fleet growth.
For context, Encord helps (Series C, $110M total raised) 200+ AV/ ADAS and
ML teams solve both - Woven by Toyota cut $2M+/yr from their data pipeline
and accelerate perception model iteration.

With [COMPANY] expanding to 200+ driverless trucks, worth a 20-min chat this
week or the next to see if we can help on the data pipeline?

subject: [NAME] - invitation to speak at Encord's Physical AI Summit in October
text:
Hi [NAME] - hope you're doing well - been a while,

Reaching out as Encord is hosting its inaugural Physical AI Summit, 'Long
Horizon,' at Fort Mason in San Francisco on Oct 20-21, and wondering if
you'd be interested in speaking at the event?

We're expecting ~600 senior leaders from the world's top AI companies, with
Day 1 focused on Robotics and Embodied AI and Day 2 on Autonomy across AV,
ADAS & Defence. Confirmed speakers include Luc Vincent (creator of Google
Street View, founder of Lyft Level 5), the Co-founder/CTO of a major
robotics lab, and an exciting lineup of founders, researchers, and
operators.

There are a couple of slots we think you'd be a great fit for, although
happy to discuss other options too:

   - Oct 20, 15:30 - Panel / Workshop: Who will win the warehouse robotics
   race?
   - Oct 20, 13:45 - Panel: Will world models eat Physical AI?

Let me know if you'd be open to it & I can connect you with our VP Growth,
[SENDER] (in cc) who is organising the summit,

subject: Swarm Aero <> Encord
text:
Hey [NAME], I lead GTM efforts for Physical AI at Encord. We work with a
number of drone and autonomous systems teams on the data infrastructure
side - managing, annotating, and curating multi-sensor and aerial video
data that feeds their models.

Many of the customers that we work with (Zipline, Skydio, Vantor, etc)
partnered with us as the scale of complexity started to break initial
tooling - multi-camera sensor fusion, large-volume flight data, edge-case
mining across diverse mission environments. The teams we work with at that
stage are usually either hitting walls with in-house annotation
infrastructure or spending engineering cycles maintaining pipelines that
need to be automated.

Curious whether that's a friction point for you right now - specifically
around how you're handling annotation and data curation as the autonomy
stack scales.

Would you be open to a quick intro chat in the next week or two?

subject: [COMPANY] <> Encord
text:
Hey [NAME], I lead GTM for Physical AI at Encord. Saw the USSOCOM contract
news; congrats, that's a significant milestone.

Given your background at Cruise, I imagine you're well aware of the data
infrastructure problem that comes next: as the system gets deployed into
real operational environments, the volume and complexity of flight data
that needs to be labelled, curated, and fed back into the model grows
faster than any internal tooling can keep up with.

We work with a number of autonomous systems teams across AV, robotics, and
UAVs on exactly that layer: managing and annotating multimodal sensor data
at scale, running active learning loops to surface edge cases from
real-world runs, and building the feedback pipelines that close the gap
between deployment and the next model iteration.

Would love to have a quick conversation to see if there's a fit. Happy to
keep it short to mind your time.

subject: [COMPANY] <> Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

Looks like you overlapped with several friends of mine at Samsara during
your time there, notably Max who was there since the early days.

I'm leading GTM efforts for Physical AI at Encord
<[LINK]>.
We've built the data platform for teams training vision AI on high-volume
video. [COMPANY] is one that I've been following for awhile, particualrly as
you've expanded into heteregenous environments.

We've partnered with a number of well-known companies developing Vision
models where Encord is well equipped to automate their data pipeline and

annotated 70,000 images in a month and cut false acceptance rates from 6%
to 1%; Standard AI saved $600k annually on video processing.

Would love to grab 20 minutes in the coming week or two to connect and
explore potential areas of fit if you or someone on the team would be up
for it.
